events.title: Ride for Zesa — Side by Side Poker Run
events.imageAlt: Ride for Zesa Side by Side Poker Run — Saturday July 11, 2026
events.detailDescription:
Ride for a cause. Every hand helps.

Saturday, July 11, 2026. Check-in opens at 10 AM at The Quarry — grab brunch before you roll out. Five stops on the route, draw a card at each, and the best poker hand at the finish takes the prize. Check back in by 4:30 PM with return to The Quarry by 5:00 PM.

The Route:
 1. The Quarry — 3960 Highway Z, New Melle, MO 63385
 2. Liz's Bar & Grill — 3585 Mill Street, New Melle, MO 63365
 3. Treloar Bar & Grill — 16843 State Highway N, Marthasville, MO 63357
 4. Cori's Twin Gables — 101 State Highway 47, Marthasville, MO 63357
 5. Return to The Quarry by 5:00 PM (check back in by 4:30 PM)

Entry: $25 per driver, $10 per passenger. Register by July 7. All proceeds go directly to Zesa Bollinger, a 22-year-old facing an extremely long and tedious recovery after a head-on collision on April 29, 2026.

Ride safe. Ride strong. Ride for Zesa.
events.additionalInfo: Register by Tuesday, July 7, 2026. All proceeds go directly to Zesa Bollinger.

Five-stop route, best poker hand wins
Return by 5 PM (check back in by 4:30 PM)

events.detailDescription:
This morning belongs to you.

Join us Sunday, November 1 from 9AM to 12PM for Moms' Morning Out — a totally 80s Singo brunch at The Quarry. Singo is bingo you play by ear: we spin the track, you mark the song. Big hair encouraged, not required.

events.name: Francis Howell 2029 Seniors Bingo Fundraiser
events.location: The Quarry — 3960 Highway Z, New Melle, MO
events.description: A night of Bingo supporting the Francis Howell Class of 2029 Seniors — five rounds, prizes, sponsored rounds, and intermission games. $30 tickets, 10% of all sales go back to the class. Every table of 4 gets a free bucket of beer or bottle of wine.
events.detailDescription:
Join us for a night of Bingo supporting the Francis Howell Class of 2029 Seniors!

Doors open at 5:30 PM, with Bingo starting at 7 PM. Five rounds of Bingo with prizes for each round winner, plus fun games during intermission and sponsored rounds throughout the night.

Tables of 4 or individual seats available — $30 per ticket. 10% of all ticket sales go directly back to the Francis Howell Class of 2029 Seniors.

Every table of 4 that registers gets a free bucket of domestic beer or a bottle of house wine for the table!

The Quarry — 3960 Highway Z, New Melle, MO 63385
events.additionalInfo: Doors 5:30 PM • Bingo starts 7 PM • 5 rounds with prizes • Games at intermission • Sponsored rounds • 36 tables and 20 individual seats only

events.detailDescription:
Rock & Vine Wine Club at The Quarry

Featured Winery: Chateau Sainte Genevieve

Thursday, September 17, 2026
6:00 PM
$39.99 per admission
The Quarry, 3960 Highway Z, New Melle, MO

Join us for a guided wine tasting experience featuring Chateau Sainte Genevieve, where you'll enjoy perfectly paired wines and food while learning more about each selection and its unique French-inspired style.

Each $39.99 admission includes:

Wine tasting for 2 people
Food pairings with each tasting
A guided tasting experience overlooking The Quarry

Bring a partner, a friend, or a date - your admission covers both of you. Reserve your spot below; we'll have your names on the list at the door.

Limited to 15 admissions (30 people).
